definitions.explanation: A state where growth, increase, or improvement has reached its limit and cannot go higher. Used for numbers, performance, prices, and similar metrics.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}が{頭打|あたまう}ちだ。
{人口|じんこう}の{増加|ぞうか}が{頭打|あたまう}ちになっている。
examples.english: Population growth has hit a ceiling.

examples.japanese: この{業界|ぎょうかい}は{成長|せいちょう}が{頭打|あたまう}ちで、{新|あたら}しい{戦略|せんりゃく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Growth in this industry has plateaued, and new strategies are needed.

notes:
KEY PATTERN:
{頭打|あたまう}ちになる (to plateau, to hit a ceiling) is the most common usage pattern. Also used as a predicate: ～が{頭打|あたまう}ちだ.

ETYMOLOGY:
{頭|あたま} (head) + {打|う}ち (hitting). The image of hitting one's head on a ceiling above, unable to go higher.

USAGE:
Primarily used in business, economics, and data contexts. Common subjects include {売上|うりあげ} (sales), {成長|せいちょう} (growth), {株価|かぶか} (stock prices), and {人口|じんこう} (population).
